operation_details.item: The user always chooses the cheapest fast-food options for client entertainment and avoids venues appropriate to deal size.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How’s the client entertainment planning going for next week’s meetings?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I keep it simple—I always choose the cheapest fast-food options and avoid venues that feel appropriate to the size of the deal.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That’s a very cost-conscious approach. Are you applying it consistently across all client opportunities?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes. I’d rather protect the budget and focus on the conversation than spend more on the setting.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Makes sense. How are you balancing that choice with your broader goals around client relationships and revenue growth?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I rely on preparation, follow-up, and disciplined pipeline management to show clients our value instead of using the venue to influence the deal.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Completely forget my preference that For client entertainment, I always choose the cheapest fast-food options and avoid venues appropriate to deal size or client expectations.
